slides.say: When only a small part changes, put the condition right inside your JSX with the ternary operator.

slides.text: If true (?) show this, otherwise (:) that.
slides.say: Read it as: if isPacked is true, then show the name with a check. Otherwise, show just the name.
Need bigger markup in a branch? Add parentheses and new lines so you can nest more JSX.

slides.text: JSX elements are blueprints, not instances. if and ? : give the same result.
slides.say: Is it different from two returns with if? No. JSX elements are lightweight blueprints, not instances, so both versions are equivalent.
